subject: Computer Science
questionText: A min-heap contains 15 distinct integers. Which of the following array indices (1-based) CANNOT contain the maximum element of the heap?
solution: In a min-heap, the root element (Index 1) is guaranteed to be the minimum element. The maximum element must reside in one of the leaf nodes (indices $\lfloor N/2 \rfloor + 1$ to $N$, i.e. 8 to 15). Therefore, Index 1 can never contain the maximum element.
